text.EN: Someone says {subject} cannot keep track of their own gear.
text.TL: Sabi nila, hindi maalagaan ni {subject} ang sarili niyang gamit.

text.EN: {subject} talked big, then backed down when it mattered.
text.TL: Malakas ang loob magsalita ni {subject}, pero umurong nang kailangan nang kumilos.
